jobs.description: The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through cutting-edge generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to set the scientific direction for the next generation of agentic AI applications that guide Amazon advertisers. In this role you will define, lead and build the science behind agentic systems that reason, plan, and act autonomously to manage and optimize ad campaigns based on a deep understanding of the advertiser and the marketplace. You will own the agentic architecture end to end, partnering closely with product and engineering leaders to translate a long-term science vision into concrete research and engineering roadmaps. Working backwards from the needs of millions of advertisers, you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, and deliver customer-facing products that help advertisers create, optimize, and grow their campaigns. You will invent new methods at the product level, and drive their adoption across multiple teams. This role combines science leadership, technical depth, product focus, and business understanding: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems. Key job responsibilities As an Applied Scientist III on this team you will: - Define the science vision for the agentic campaign management system and, with product and engineering leaders, turn it into delivery roadmaps. - Build agentic systems that autonomously manage and optimize ad campaigns — encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, keyword and targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health. - Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these agents — advertiser and campaign data, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance. - Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take agentic systems from prototype to launch. - Own the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), long-horizon reasoning (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and multi-agent orchestration — and stay deeply hands-on, writing production-quality, critical-path code from prototype to launch. - Define the evaluation and safety methodology for agent workflows and drive its adoption as the bar for reliability and trust. - Drive the team's scientific agenda, mentor scientists and engineers, and represent the team in the internal and external scientific community. About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through the latest generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. This team within Sponsored Products and Brands is focused on guiding and supporting millions of advertisers to meet their advertising needs of creating and managing ad campaigns. At this scale, the complexity of diverse advertiser goals, campaign types, and market dynamics creates both a massive technical challenge and a transformative opportunity: even small improvements in guidance systems can have outsized impact on advertiser success and Amazon’s retail ecosystem. Our vision is to build a highly personalized, context-aware agentic advertiser guidance system that leverages LLMs together with tools such as auction simulations, ML models, and optimization algorithms. This agentic framework, will operate across both chat and non-chat experiences in the ad console, scaling to natural language queries as well as autonomously manage campaigns based on deep understanding of the advertiser. To execute this vision, we collaborate closely with stakeholders across Ad Console, Sales, and Marketing to identify opportunities—from high-level product guidance down to granular keyword recommendations—and deliver them through a tailored, personalized experience. Our work is grounded in state-of-the-art agent architectures, tool integration, reasoning frameworks, and model customization approaches (including tuning, MCP, and preference optimization), ensuring our systems are both scalable and adaptive.

Join Amazon Pharmacy's Supply Chain team and help shape how medications reach patients. Amazon Pharmacy is looking for an experienced Instock Manager with proven experience managing complex inbound supply chains in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. You will join a high-powered, collaborative team where you partner across multiple functions to keep patients supplied with the medications they depend on.

Pharmacy is one of the most meaningful and interesting supply chains you can work on. Every in-stock decision you make helps ensure a patient gets the medication they're counting on, so your work has a direct, tangible impact on people's health. It's also a rich problem space: you'll navigate product expiry, controlled-substance handling, and state-by-state regulations, solving challenges that don't exist in traditional retail. If you want the ownership of an instock role plus a mission that matters, this is a rare place to build.

The Instock Manager will be responsible for all aspects of the Instock role, including driving improved in-stock, inventory planning, and vendor operational improvement (efficiency, fill rates, lead times). You will drive initiatives to improve patient experience, reduce cost, and improve inventory health by working collaboratively across pharmacy operations, supply chain, procurement, and compliance teams. The ideal candidate excels in scalable process improvement, automation, and analytics, and is energized by solving complex problems and turning manual processes into scalable ones.

Strong written and verbal communication skills are required, and the candidate should be comfortable engaging with both internal stakeholders and vendors. The candidate will have proven experience delivering results by partnering with others and be comfortable contributing across a range of topics outside the core ISM responsibilities.

Key job responsibilities
Maintain excellent in-stock rates for owned category and/or region while minimizing expiry and unhealthy inventory
Execute inventory strategies to optimize service levels, turns, and inventory health under expiry and controlled-substance constraints
Monitor, analyze, and own key performance indicators such as in-stock rate, target inventory levels, fill rate, turns, and expiry/write-off rates
Manage efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows and health, including supporting purchasing processes and removing unproductive or expiring inventory in a compliant manner
Drive root cause analysis and reporting on operational issues, develop action plans, and project manage improvements while managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Partner with vendor managers to drive vendor performance across fill rate, lead time, and reliability
Work collaboratively with internal teams to drive tools and process improvements affecting purchasing and procurement workflows, with emphasis on automating tasks currently performed manually
Ensure inventory and procurement decisions adhere to pharmacy regulatory and compliance requirements across states

Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale. Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde. Un employeur de choix Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale. Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ? Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable principal(e) de l’industrialisation avancée expérimenté(e), doté(e) d’une forte expertise technique, d’une approche proactive et d’une grande capacité à travailler de manière transversale. Cette personne sera responsable de définir les stratégies d’approvisionnement et de fabrication, ainsi que de piloter la mise en œuvre de nouveaux composants durables (pièces et modules), des activités d’assemblage et d’essais moteurs (A&T), tout en soutenant les activités de préparation liées au niveau de maturité de fabrication (MRL). Ce poste requiert une approche stratégique axée sur la gestion des risques, ainsi qu’une forte capacité d’innovation et d’adaptation pour évoluer au sein de chaînes d’approvisionnement mondiales et de sites de production multiples, dans un environnement hautement réglementé et axé sur la performance. Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel. À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien ? Stratégie d’approvisionnement et de fabrication Piloter les activités d’approvisionnement et de fabrication des composants, modules, systèmes d’assemblage, d’essais et d’outillage pour les nouveaux programmes moteurs. Définir les stratégies « make, buy or partner » pour les nouveaux composants en fonction des exigences techniques, opérationnelles et industrielles. Identifier, évaluer et développer les fournisseurs, partenaires et technologies de fabrication avancées (fonderie de précision, usinage de superalliages, revêtements, fabrication additive, etc.). Établir des stratégies de double ou multi-sourcing et élaborer des plans d’atténuation des risques en collaboration avec les équipes d’industrialisation. Négociation et partenariats stratégiques Mener les négociations des ententes à long terme avant les attributions de production. Négocier les prix, coûts non récurrents, échéanciers de développement, accords de réparation et révision, outillage ainsi que les modalités contractuelles. Collaborer avec les équipes Partenariats pour développer des modèles de partage des risques liés aux projets de développement industriel. Optimisation industrielle et préparation à la production Impliquer les fournisseurs, partenaires et sites dès les premières phases de développement afin d’optimiser la conception, la fabricabilité, l’assemblage et les coûts des produits (DfC, DFM, DFA). Soutenir les évaluations de maturité technologique (TRL) et industrielle (MRL). Assurer l’alignement des plans de production et des activités de préparation opérationnelle avec les échéanciers des programmes. About this role

About the Korea Institutional Client Business Team

The Korea Institutional Client Business (ICB) team is responsible for developing and managing BlackRock’s relationships with Korea’s leading institutional investors, including pension funds, sovereign and public institutions, insurance companies, securities firms, asset managers, and other asset owners. The team partners closely with clients to deliver investment insights, portfolio solutions, and access to BlackRock’s global investment capabilities across public and private markets, helping clients achieve their long-term investment objectives.

Roles & Responsibilities:

• Reporting to the Head of Institutional Client Business, Korea, drive BlackRock's institutional client strategy to accelerate business growth, deepen client relationships, and expand the firm's presence across key Korean institutional investors, including sovereign and public institutions, pension funds, insurance companies, securities firms, and other asset owners.
• Develop and strengthen senior relationships with key institutional investors, acting as a trusted partner and representing BlackRock's broad investment capabilities across public while supporting private market opportunities where appropriate.
• Lead business development efforts across strategic institutional accounts, identifying client needs, market trends, and investment opportunities to drive asset growth and revenue generation.
• Build and execute a high-quality institutional pipeline by leveraging BlackRock's broad capabilities to deliver customized portfolio solutions that address clients' strategic investment objectives.
• Lead complex client engagements, including investment presentations, due diligence meetings, RFP processes, and mandate negotiations, to secure new business and retain existing assets.
• Monitor client portfolios, investment themes, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics within the Korean institutional market to proactively identify growth opportunities.
• Collaborate closely with regional and global investment professionals, product specialists, and business partners to deliver differentiated investment solutions and an exceptional client experience.
• Serve as a senior member of the Korea Institutional Client Business team, contributing to talent development, team engagement, governance, and an inclusive, high-performance culture.

• 15+ years of experience in the asset management or broader financial services industry, with a proven track record in institutional client coverage, business development, and relationship management.
• Deep understanding of the Korean institutional investor landscape, including pension funds, insurance companies, sovereign and public institutions, financial institutions, and local distribution channels.
• Demonstrated success in developing and managing senior-level client relationships, with the ability to navigate complex organizations and engage effectively with key investment and business decision-makers.
• Strong knowledge of investment products and solutions with the ability to engage clients on asset allocation, portfolio construction, and investment strategies.
• Strategic and commercially minded, strong market awareness, and the ability to identify and execute on evolving client opportunities.
• Excellent relationship management, communication, and presentation skills.
• Highly collaborative team player with experience working effectively across global, regional, and local teams within a complex, matrixed organization.
• Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including a commitment to fostering an inclusive culture, developing talent, and contributing to broader organizational success.
• Highest standard of professional and ethical conduct.
•

Native-level Korean and strong business proficiency in both written and spoken English.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

jobs.description: Team Name: Public Relations Job Title: Senior Director, International Communications Requisition ID: R028259 Job Description: REPORTS TO: Vice President, Blizzard Communications LOCATION: Irvine, CA (Hybrid) YOUR MISSION The Senior Director of International Communications for Blizzard will lead franchise, brand, and reputation communications across international markets (EMEA, LATAM, APAC), acting as the senior strategic leader for the international communications organization and the connective tissue between global strategy and regional execution. This role shapes how players, creators, and media around the world experience and talk about Blizzard's franchises throughout the year, translating global narratives into cohesive market plans, campaigns, and moments that land with cultural credibility in Europe, Asia, Latin America, and beyond. Operating with autonomy as the international communications lead for Blizzard, the Senior Director sets direction across launches, live service momentum, franchise storytelling, and community engagement, while driving operational excellence and cross functional alignment at scale. A defining part of the role is judgment: evaluating where the highest impact communications opportunities sit across a broad portfolio of markets and moments, choosing what to invest in, knowing what to leave on the table and driving clarity and alignment on the approach. This role is a key connector across global comms, international marketing and publishing, development teams, legal, and customer support, and a trusted voice in the most visible and most sensitive moments for the business internationally. This is a people leadership role first. You will lead, coach, and grow a distributed team of regional communications leaders across time zones and cultures, setting a clear vision, raising the creative bar, and creating the conditions for seasoned operators to do the best work of their careers. We are looking for someone thoughtful and strategic, with the creative instinct to imagine communications work no one has seen before and the discipline to make it real across many markets at once. While your role is specifically focused on Blizzard communications, it sits within the XBOX Communications team, the team responsible for championing player first storytelling and innovative communications that serve passionate players globally. You will work closely with peers across the business, sharing best practices, insights, and approaches that strengthen communications across markets and across our broad set of games. RESPONSIBILITIES Own the international communications strategy for Blizzard franchises, brand, and reputation, ensuring player first, culturally relevant storytelling that is aligned to global strategy and business priorities in every region. Lead, develop, and grow a distributed team of regional communications leaders, setting clear goals and expectations, coaching for craft and judgment, and building a bench of future-ready leaders. Evaluate and prioritize the highest impact communications opportunities across markets, moments, and franchises, making clear recommendations about where to invest and where to decline. Provide strategic leadership across launches, live operations, seasonal beats, and ongoing franchise momentum, balancing long lead planning with the short lead opportunities that define a live service business. Lead the development and delivery of international PR campaigns, creative storytelling platforms, and media, creator, and talent moments and events that elevate company and franchise narratives. Shape and steward messaging frameworks and narratives, including press materials, Q and As, talking points, and briefing documents for spokespeople and partners in market. Build and maintain senior level relationships with priority international gaming, tech, mainstream, culture and lifestyle media, and with the influencers and creators who shape how our games are understood, acting as a trusted point of contact for the business. Set the international creator and earned media strategy for prioritized franchises, defining clear objectives, audience opportunities, KPIs, and measurement frameworks that regional teams can execute against. Serve as an embedded communications partner to regional marketing and publishing, development teams, legal, and customer support, influencing plans, timing, and execution rather than reacting to them. Protect and strengthen brand reputation internationally, leading issues management with sound judgment, identifying risk early, developing recommendations, and partnering closely with global and regional stakeholders. Partner with agencies across regions with clear direction and accountability, ensuring high quality delivery, strong judgment, and measurable results against goals. Drive measurement, reporting, and insights, using performance data and learnings to inform optimization, investment decisions, and future planning across markets. Manage international communications budget, including forecasting, spend tracking, headcount planning, and resource prioritization. Represent international communications with confidence and clarity in senior leadership, regional, and cross functional forums, and bring the voice of players in market back into global planning. Partner strategically with marketing and the business on emerging markets approach. PLAYER PROFILE Minimum Requirements Extensive experience in communications, public relations, creator relations, or a closely related field, including significant time leading communications across multiple international markets. 12+ years in communications or public relations, including 5+ years leading and developing teams, and significant experience across international markets. Willingness to work out of Blizzard HQ in Irvine, California. 3 days a week in office. Proven people leadership experience, including managing managers or senior individual contributors across regions, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong communicators. Demonstrated success building and executing brand, franchise, or product communications strategies in markets such as Europe, Asia, and Latin America, with an understanding of how one narrative has to flex by culture and media landscape. Deep media, creator, and influencer relationships, and the credibility to counsel senior spokespeople and prepare them for high visibility moments. Experience leading issues and crisis communications for a consumer brand, with the judgment to know what to escalate, what to answer, and what to let pass. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including editing, message development, and the ability to turn complex information into a story people want to read. Strong strategic thinking paired with operational rigor, comfortable owning budgets, agency rosters, planning calendars, and measurement. Ability to work across a large, matrixed organization and to build trust quickly with partners in other functions and other time zones. Willingness to travel internationally and to work across time zones with regional teams and partners. Extra Points Experience in games, entertainment, or another fandom driven business, and genuine curiosity about how player communities work. Familiarity with Blizzard franchises and the communities around them. Experience communicating around live service titles, seasonal content, and long running franchises. Fluency in a second language relevant to a priority international market. Experience standing up new communications capabilities, teams, or ways of working in a market. OUR WORLD At Blizzard Entertainment, we pour our hearts and souls into everything we create. Best known for iconic video game universes including Warcraft, Overwatch, Diablo, and StarCraft, we’ve been creating genre-defining games for millions of players around the world for more than 30 years. We’re on a quest: bring our dreams to life and craft the most epic entertainment experiences…ever. Hard work, iteration and polish go into the Blizzard “secret recipe,” but the most important ingredients come from talented people who share our vision. If that sounds like you, join us. The videogame industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics. Rewards We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including: Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance; 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching; Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave; Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others; If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance. Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting https://www.benefitsforeveryworld.com/ . In the U.S., the standard base pay range for this role is $151,420.00 - $280,134.00 Annual. jobs.description: Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control tower for 'Quick Commerce Execution' across Amazon's ultra-fast delivery network. It ensures the hassle-free, on-time flow of inventory across all hops — from hubs to Micro-Fulfillment Centers (MFCs) and onward to the customer. In case of any exceptions, the NOC steps in to resolve the issue in real time and keeps all stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving, the NOC is charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline hyperlocal operations — work that involves live network monitoring and significant analysis of high-velocity delivery data. Coordinate actions across teams — mobilizing operations, tech, program, and field teams to keep the network in flow when disruptions hit. Build learnings for next time — codifying every intervention into playbooks and reusable recovery frameworks so the network responds faster with each recurrence. Track until normal state — owning each disruption from detection through recovery, confirming stabilization before closing the loop. Leadership Scope: The incumbent will lead a team of L2s, L3s, and managers. THE PERSON You are an EDA-centric engineer who views the design flow as a system to be tuned, automated, and perfected. You are not just a user of tools; you are an expert in how tool algorithms, constraints, and physical parameters interact to produce optimal silicon. If you are driven by the challenge of reducing turnaround time, improving design predictability, and pushing EDA tools to their absolute limits, you are the ideal candidate for this role. EDA Tool Optimization: Act as the primary interface with EDA vendors to drive tool adoption, evaluate new features, and troubleshoot complex tool-behavior issues. Methodology Development: Develop and deploy advanced scripting frameworks (Tcl/Python) to automate design space exploration, ECO implementation, and multi-corner timing closure. PPA Optimization: Systematically analyze and tune tool settings—including placement density, routing congestion management, and clock tree synthesis (CTS) strategies—to meet aggressive frequency and power targets. Signoff Integration: Build and refine automated signoff loops (STA, IR/EM, Physical Verification) to ensure high-confidence tape-outs with minimal iterations. Constraint Engineering: Develop and validate complex SDC constraints, ensuring that tool-driven optimizations are aligned with architectural intent and physical realities. Data-Driven Analysis: Utilize big-data approaches to analyze design metrics across multiple iterations, identifying trends in tool performance and implementing corrective methodology improvements. jobs.description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. What you’ll be doing... As a full-time Verizon Retail Sales Associate, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career with a team focused on unlocking your full potential and sales success within one of our retail stores. Here's what you can expect: Generate retail sales by using your passion for cutting-edge technology, and exceptional customer service to expand the Verizon network. Learn and uncover customers' needs by creating connections and asking the right questions. Position product insights and solution recommendations to provide customers with a complete top-down sales solution. Close sales by using phenomenal communication skills to fulfill customer needs with simple and intuitive tech solutions. Continuously develop yourself through ongoing training and up-skill in operational functions across merchandising and inventory. Potential to grow your customer base by placing outbound calls and sending text messages to current Verizon customers who are interested in our products and services. Opportunities to engage with the community outside of the store to expand your loyal customer base, including at off-site Verizon sponsored events. We’re hiring immediately! This isn't your typical entry-level retail position. Whether you're just starting out or have years of sales experience, you can earn $16.00 to $21.00 per hour in base pay, plus up to $18,000 a year in individual-based commissions if you hit all your sales goals. Planning to go above and beyond? With our commission program, the opportunities are unlimited for employees who exceed their sales goals. Top performers could make an extra $14,500 or more in individual-based commissions, giving you the chance to earn a total of $65,000+ to $75,500+ annually. Compensation varies by geography, hours worked, and performance. Our comprehensive benefits (starting day one) and perks are designed to help you move forward in your career and in your life outside of Verizon. From health and well-being benefits to investment in your education and career, we've got you covered! Bilingual speakers in eligible locations may receive an extra $3,000 annually on top of their base pay and commission after passing a language assessment Best in class medical, dental, and vision Verizon 401(k) plan with matching contributions up to 6% of eligible participant contributions to the plan, qualified student loan repayments, or a combination of both Sales recognition programs that have, in the past, awarded top performers with all inclusive travel to domestic and international destinations, gifts, and other incentives Five weeks of paid time off (vacation, holidays, personal days) 8 weeks of paid parental leave for eligible new parents (when paired with short-term disability, this benefit may provide up to 16 weeks of paid time off for the birthing parent) Up to $8K per year in tuition assistance Discounts up to 50% off on Verizon products and services Additional employee discounts on attractions, automotive, travel and more. This position is a great way to jumpstart your career! Too good to be true? Hear from our Verizon Retail team members on what it's like to be part of a team that invests in you. From our in-person new hire experience and award-winning training programs to our culture of learning and amazing benefits, you’ll be able to apply your skills while elevating your career. What we’re looking for... You’ll need to have: High school diploma or GED. One or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and holidays (you'll know your schedule four weeks in advance). Openness to pick up additional shifts and earn more income, typically during the summer months, November through December, and/or during peak vacation periods. Even better if you have one or more of the following: Bilingual Fluency in English and Spanish. Experience working in a commission-based environment. Demonstrated sales experience communicating with customers to find solutions. Customer service experience. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. After you apply… You may be required to take an assessment. It takes about 19 minutes to complete. If you’re selected to move forward, one of our recruiters will reach out to tell you more about the role and answer your questions. Where you’ll be working In this worksite-based role, you'll work onsite at a defined location(s). Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. Benefits and Compensation Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. This is a commission based position with the potential to earn more.

Job Description: We are seeking an experienced senior software engineer to drive complex feature enhancements, architecture improvements, and high-tier escalation resolution for our enterprise security product suite. In this role, you will balance core software engineering—designing cross-platform components, APIs, and distributed systems—with deep debugging and hotfix engineering for critical customer issues. Key Responsibilities Design and implement new software components and new features that meet functional and business requirements on schedule and within budget. Utilize different programming languages to create cross-platform code (UNIX, Linux, Mac, and Windows platforms) that will run in physical (hardware) and virtual environments (Azure and AWS). Define communication interfaces between software components, implement new product APIs, and consume 3rd party interfaces in product software components. Utilize network protocols and apply software clustering models to build distributed enterprise-grade software that can be deployed and synchronized in multiple datacenters across the globe. Use Relational Databases (SQL) and Directories (LDAP). Design database tables and schemas to store product-specific information and integrate the product with customers' provided databases and LDAP directories. Utilize modern UI frameworks for development of end-user-facing interfaces, web protocols, and REST APIs. Work collaboratively within an Agile Team to write high-quality, testable code that meets the Definition of Done. Perform unit/module testing of software to find errors and confirm programs meet specifications. Utilize unit testing frameworks to build unit tests. Implement end-to-end automation tests. Provide information to technical writers and conduct training sessions on new modules or code changes to other members of the product cross-functional team. Integrate new product features and tests into the continuous integration toolchain. Leverage AI-assisted development tools and identify opportunities to adopt innovative technologies. Troubleshoot product issues, fix defects, and work closely with customers to drive platform quality. Utilize debugging and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex configuration issues or product defects reported by the customers. Work on recreating product issues in the lab environment and be able to troubleshoot issues in customer environments using remote tools. Provide guidance and best practices on product deployment models and configurations. Support regular cadence of product update releases such as service packs and produce individual hotfixes and code patches. Skills Required Strong design, programming (Java, C, C++, PHP, Perl, SQL, and shell scripts), and debugging skills with experience on enterprise-class applications. Strong knowledge of Windows / Unix / Linux operating systems Internals and experience with cross-platform software development Very good at debugging multi-threaded, high-performance applications Ability to use AI tools effectively to improve efficiency and productivity Enterprise Security domain knowledge and experience (authentication/authorization frameworks, security protocols, PKI, certificates, SSL, Privileged Access and Identity use cases) Good communication, coaching, and mentoring skills. Work Experience Typically, 10+ years of experience in software development What makes you a strong fit? AI Expertise: You are an expert in using AI code assist tools (Claude/Cursor, etc.) as coworkers and not as prompt engineers. Good understanding of AI Spec-driven development methodologies like Plan/BMAD mode, etc., and use it thoroughly to map out and implement all phases of SDLC. Understand agent orchestration and manage multi-agent workflows to handle complex, multi-step engineering tasks like new capabilities, codebase refactoring, upgrades, and vulnerability patching. Code Review & Quality Control: Critically review AI-generated code for architectural alignment, design, and performance bottlenecks. Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law. If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence.
